title: peucedanum elatior
intro: Peucedanum elatior, commonly known as Giant Hog's Fennel, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and act as a diuretic. The health benefits of Peucedanum elatior include its potential to reduce inflammation, ease respiratory issues, and support liver function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
